title: The Pulse: Details of incident.io’s AI spend
author: Ivan Klaric
description: The resiliency startup has slashed the amount it spends on AI; down from $4,500 per dev, per month, in August, to $1,600 now.
summary: Hi, this is Gergely with a bonus, free issue of the Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter. In every issue, I cover Big Tech and startups through the lens of senior engineers and engineering leaders.
takeaways: The company has used AI-assisted IDEs since the beginning, such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor.
Infrastructure teams might use Claude to explore production environments or do lots of analysis or run benchmarks etc which don’t lead to PRs, so their cost per-PR looks higher.
Different types of work will simply have different cost profiles.” Measuring ROI Today, average spend is down at ~$1,600/engineer/month, of which around 80% is on Claude, with 20% going to Cursor.
